root_cause.text: The strp_abort_strp() function fails to free the partially assembled skb stored in strp->skb_head when aborting the stream parser, causing a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `kfree_skb(strp->skb_head)` and resets `strp->skb_head`, `strp->skb_nextp`, and `strp->need_bytes` in `strp_abort_strp()`, and the CVE description explicitly states that "That skb is not released in strp_abort_strp(), which leaks the partially assembled message".
